test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain coding language, MORE is written as LNQD and STOP is written as RSNO. How will TOY be written in that language?
solution:
**Option 2 is the correct answer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

The pattern followed here is as follows:

MORE is written as LNQD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ce49d8821faa478a8c321c2f8977332ea6f470feefd18223983779b4ea0d386.png] 

And,

STOP is written as RSNO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71fd69fae1faf2d2df6cae0ecd0fe3017828d7f8b5c1c59f3288d5bc703cdaaf.png] 

Similarly,

TOY be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da6bfecc1edf274e0639f5e19d90b73dca94abef653610777f3b027eeb47ec44.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****SNX". **
